goals: Qualified client inquiries for remote, smaller, clearly scoped software projects
data_sources: Local service content and analytics documentation

method.geographic_comparison: Single worldwide regional-interest export for workflow automation; every listed country shares one geographic scale
method.normalization: 0–100 relative interest; independently normalized requests cannot be compared as absolute volumes
method.language_note: Search terms are language-specific; no Google language filter was applied.

exploratory_buyer_average_indices.caution: Automation consultant also includes industrial automation. Short buyer phrases are sparse and noisy.

swedish_service_average_indices.caution: Sparse, mostly zero observations; automatisering also returns iPhone-related searches. No reliable language preference or demand forecast.

emerging_buyer_average_indices.caution: Insufficient data in technology category. Category-sensitive signal; treat as a test, not proven customer demand.

key_findings: Workflow automation leads the filtered global service comparison in 12-month and 90-day windows, and leads in US and UK country checks.
Matched summer weeks show roughly 5.9x workflow automation relative search interest versus 2025; API integration is approximately flat.
English workflow automation regional interest indices: UK 21, US 20, Canada 14, Germany 9, Netherlands 8, Sweden 4. These are search shares, not market size or clients.
Broad Swedish role terms attract education/job searches. Swedish service terms and English buyer phrases in Sweden are sparse.
Existing site has separate bilingual integration, app improvement and code review pages; older cached assertion that these were missing is superseded.
User clarified that Trafikverket work was primarily in K2; this supports process/workflow automation positioning.
issues: Related-query results include clearly irrelevant terms; excluded those from decisions.
No private Search Console, keyword volume, competition, conversion or revenue data were used.
recommendations: First test English workflow automation service positioning plus a Swedish counterpart.
Strengthen existing bilingual API integration pages using the KYC/Salesforce work at Trustly.
Test an AI-built app review/fix offer as a bounded experiment, without claiming platform expertise not demonstrated.
Measure qualified inquiries, agreed scopes and won projects; establish a baseline before growth targets.
tool_limitations: Google Trends sampling, low-volume suppression, noise and rolling dates limit reproducibility.
No defensible client count, budget, rankability or seasonality estimate from Trends.
The custom Analytics Engine events do not attribute organic sources or individual visitor journeys.

experience_clarification.Trafikverket: Work was primarily in K2, a process/workflow automation framework.
experience_clarification.positioning: Use K2 work as evidence for process and workflow automation; use Trustly KYC/Salesforce work for the integration offer.
experience_clarification.correction: Earlier SOAP/XML emphasis overstated the role of custom integration work in the Trafikverket assignment.
